Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.model

package net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.model
The parsed DOT graph: subgraphs, nodes, edges and their attributes, following the semantics of Graphviz.

  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    DotAttributes
    An ordered set of DOT attributes (name=value).
    DotEdge
    An edge of a DOT graph.
    DotGraph
    A parsed DOT graph: the root subgraph, plus every node and edge in creation order.
    DotGraphBuilder
    Builds a DotGraph statement after statement, applying the DOT semantics of Graphviz (cgraph and its grammar): a node is created at its first mention, with the node defaults visible at that moment in the current subgraph; mentioning it again inside another subgraph only adds it to that subgraph; an edge gets the edge defaults visible in the current subgraph, then the attributes of its statement; in a strict graph, a second edge between the same two nodes (in either direction for an undirected graph) is the same edge: only its attributes are merged; reopening a named subgraph in the same parent continues it.
    DotNode
    A node of a DOT graph.
    DotSubgraph
    A subgraph of a DOT graph, or the root graph itself.
    DotValue
    The value of a DOT attribute.
